name: MEDIQA-QA
intro: MEDIQA-QA是ACL BioNLP Workshop发布的医疗问答推理基准，旨在推动自然语言推理和问题蕴涵识别在医疗问答领域的应用，要求参与者对提供的答案进行正确性判断和重新排序。
org: U.S. National Library of Medicine, IBM Research
build_method: 消费者健康问题收集, CHiQA检索, 医学专家评分与重排
metric: 准确率、平均倒数排名、精确率、Spearman秩相关系数
task_type: 答案验证, 答案排序
eval_feature: 医疗问答推理，自然语言推理和问题蕴涵识别
build_method_en: Consumer-health question collection, CHiQA retrieval, medical-expert rating and reranking
eval_feature_en: Medical QA reasoning, natural language inference and question entailment recognition
intro_en: MEDIQA-QA is a medical question answering reasoning benchmark released by the ACL BioNLP Workshop. It aims to advance the application of natural language inference and question entailment recognition in the medical QA domain, requiring participants to assess the correctness of provided answers and reorder them accordingly.
mermaid_flowchart:
flowchart LR
    A(Medical Knowledge Bases) --> B[Expert Data Selection]
    B --> C[Question Formulation]
    C --> D[Answer Generation]

    F --> G{Quality Check}
    G -- Approved --> H(MEDIQA-QA Dataset)

    I --> C
    H --> J[Model Evaluation]

metric_en: Accuracy, Mean Reciprocal Rank, Precision, Spearman's rank correlation
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Form 208 training questions from TREC LiveQA and Alexa"] --> B["Use CHiQA to retrieve 1,701 training answers"]
    B --> C["Create 25 validation and 150 test questions with 1,341 CHiQA answers"]
    C --> D["Have medical experts assign four-level relevance scores and ranks 1 to 11"]
    D --> E["Release 383 questions and 3,042 candidate answers with gold scores and ranks"]
    E --> F["Optionally add RQE over MedQuAD and NLI evidence"]
    F --> G["Predict relevance, filter incorrect answers, and rerank candidates"]
    G --> H["Report Accuracy, MRR, Precision, and Spearman rank correlation"]

drawio_review_note: Aligned with the MEDIQA 2019 shared-task paper (ACL Anthology W19-5039), Sections 2.3, 3.3, 4.1, and 5.3. The diagrams preserve the two 104-question training sources and their 839/862 CHiQA answers, the 25-question/234-answer validation set, the 150-question/1,107-answer test set, medical-expert relevance scores 4 to 1 and ranks 1 to 11, optional RQE/NLI evidence, and all four official metrics: Accuracy, MRR, Precision, and Spearman's rho. Both 1625 by 501 desktop exports were visually reviewed without clipping, overlap, or connector-node crossings.
